subscriptions_limits_positive_ck.name: subscriptions_limits_positive_ck
subscriptions_limits_positive_ck.value: ("business_subscriptions"."branch_limit" IS NULL OR "business_subscriptions"."branch_limit" > 0) AND ("business_subscriptions"."employee_limit" IS NULL OR "business_subscriptions"."employee_limit" > 0)

credit_customers_name_phone_ck.name: credit_customers_name_phone_ck
credit_customers_name_phone_ck.value: "credit_customers"."name" = trim("credit_customers"."name") AND char_length("credit_customers"."name") >= 2 AND "credit_customers"."phone" = trim("credit_customers"."phone") AND char_length("credit_customers"."phone") >= 7

inventory_count_items_quantities_ck.name: inventory_count_items_quantities_ck
inventory_count_items_quantities_ck.value: "inventory_count_items"."expected_quantity" >= 0 AND ("inventory_count_items"."counted_quantity" IS NULL OR "inventory_count_items"."counted_quantity" >= 0) AND (("inventory_count_items"."counted_quantity" IS NULL AND "inventory_count_items"."variance_quantity" IS NULL) OR ("inventory_count_items"."counted_quantity" IS NOT NULL AND "inventory_count_items"."variance_quantity" = "inventory_count_items"."counted_quantity" - "inventory_count_items"."expected_quantity")) AND (("inventory_count_items"."posting_quantity_before" IS NULL AND "inventory_count_items"."posted_adjustment" IS NULL) OR ("inventory_count_items"."counted_quantity" IS NOT NULL AND "inventory_count_items"."posting_quantity_before" >= 0 AND "inventory_count_items"."posted_adjustment" = "inventory_count_items"."counted_quantity" - "inventory_count_items"."posting_quantity_before"))

payment_banks_account_ck.name: payment_banks_account_ck
payment_banks_account_ck.value: "payment_banks"."bank_name" = trim("payment_banks"."bank_name") AND char_length("payment_banks"."bank_name") > 0 AND "payment_banks"."account_name" = trim("payment_banks"."account_name") AND char_length("payment_banks"."account_name") > 0 AND "payment_banks"."account_number" ~ '^[0-9]+$'

sale_items_values_ck.name: sale_items_values_ck
sale_items_values_ck.value: "sale_items"."quantity" > 0 AND "sale_items"."unit_price" >= 0 AND "sale_items"."cost_price_snapshot" >= 0 AND "sale_items"."discount" >= 0 AND "sale_items"."line_total" = round("sale_items"."quantity" * "sale_items"."unit_price") - "sale_items"."discount" AND "sale_items"."line_total" >= 0
